title: Confluent Cloud Cloud API secret (unprefixed, pre-2025-07-30): one-property twin (context)
summary: 10 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is unchanged but the carrier lacks the marker that makes the value identifiable. Legacy mutation notes: context: the same-line confluent keyword removed (CONFLUENT_API_SECRET renamed KAFKA_API_SECRET), context: the same-line confluent keyword removed (CONFLUENT_CLOUD_API_SECRET renamed KAFKA_API_SECRET), and context: the same-line confluent keyword removed (CONFLUENT_CLOUD_API_SECRET renamed SASL_PASSWORD), and 5 more. Twin of "Confluent Cloud Cloud API secret (unprefixed, pre-2025-07-30): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
